t: This is Fitzroy Street, in the London Borough of Camden. Its name comes from Henry FitzRoy, the first Duke of Grafton, an illegitimate son of King Charles the Second and his mistress Barbara Villiers. He was a soldier, made colonel of the Grenadier Guards in 1681, and Vice-Admiral of England from 1682 to 1689. He died in 1690, killed in the storming of Cork during the Williamite and Jacobite war. Not far off, Grafton Way carries his title.
